errors.unknown: That did not work. Your inputs are preserved. Please try again.
errors.PLAN_DISABLED: Planning is disabled on this server.
errors.PLAN_NOT_FOUND: There is no plan for this trip yet.
errors.PLAN_REVISION_CONFLICT: The plan has changed. The current version is loaded; review your inputs again.
errors.PLAN_PROTECTED: This fixed entry is protected. Edit its booking instead.
errors.PLAN_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This change was already sent with different content. Load the current version.
errors.PLAN_AI_CONSENT: Enable AI help for this trip if you want to use it.
errors.PLAN_AI_UNAVAILABLE: No permitted AI provider is available. Manual planning still works.
errors.PLAN_AI_NO_ITEMS: There are no movable plan items yet.
errors.PLAN_AI_INVALID: The AI response could not be safely used. Your plan is unchanged.
errors.PLAN_DAILY_LIMIT: The daily limit has been reached. You can continue planning manually.
errors.PLAN_WEATHER_LOCATION: Set a weather location in the trip settings first.
errors.PLAN_WEATHER_HORIZON: The trip is outside the forecast window.
errors.PLAN_WEATHER_PAST: Observed weather for past trips is available in TravStats.
errors.PLAN_WEATHER_UNAVAILABLE: The weather provider is unavailable. The saved forecast is preserved.
errors.PLAN_PROPOSAL_STALE: This proposal is stale. Generate it again.
errors.PLAN_PROPOSAL_CONFLICT: The proposal creates a conflict and was not applied.
errors.PLAN_EXECUTION_DATE: Add the actual date before confirming the experience.
errors.PLAN_UNDO_STALE: Further edits exist. Only the latest change can be undone.
errors.PLAN_EXECUTION_DETAILS: Review departure and arrival airports (IATA) and the dates in the booking before confirming.
errors.PLAN_EXECUTION_FUTURE: This trip is still in the future. Confirm it after it has actually happened.
errors.PLAN_EXECUTION_LINK: Link the actual record from TravStats.
errors.PLAN_EXECUTION_EDITED: This record has been edited in TravStats. Reconcile it there to preserve its information.
errors.LLM_REQUEST_POLICY: The configured AI provider is not permitted for this request.
errors.PLAN_ANCHOR_STALE: A fixed booking changed in TravStats. Refresh the plan’s source bookings first.
errors.LLM_DISABLED: AI is disabled on this server.
errors.LLM_CLOUD_NOT_CONSENTED: Cloud providers have not been approved on this server.
errors.LLM_UNREACHABLE: The AI provider is currently unreachable.
errors.PLAN_TOO_LARGE: The plan is too large to save. Remove entries or ideas you no longer need, then try again.
errors.PLAN_ITEM_NOT_FOUND: This entry no longer exists – it was probably deleted in the meantime. Reload the page to see the current version.
errors.PLAN_PROPOSAL_NOT_FOUND: This proposal no longer exists. Generate a new one if you need it.
errors.PLAN_DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: A linked document does not belong to this trip (any more). Remove it from the booking and save again.
errors.PLAN_WEATHER_INVALID: The weather provider returned unusable data. The saved forecast is preserved; try again later.
errors.PLAN_INVALID_NIGHT: This kind of night does not fit how you arrive.
errors.PLAN_SHAPE_IN_USE: The plan has stations; remove them before it becomes a single-destination plan again.

openDay: Open this day to ideas again
transferIntro: Have you already arranged the journey in between? A short answer is enough.
transferAssumption: Duration and baggage buffer are your own estimates. This does not make a booking.
bookingsIntro: Review confirmations before they become part of your plan.
noCandidates: No reliable booking details were found. You can enter them manually.
retain: Explicitly keep the original with this trip
aiIntro: A transparent proposal when you ask for one. Fixed bookings remain protected.
aiEnable: Enable AI planning help for this trip
cloudEnable: Also allow cloud providers already configured and consented to
aiConsent: The default permits local providers only. Private notes, booking references and travel documents are not included in the planning context.
request: What would you like help with?
requestExample: Make the arrival day more relaxed and account for transfer buffers. Please explain in English.
stale: This proposal no longer matches the current plan. Please generate it again.
packIntro: Packing help for your destination and plans. Your own quantities are preserved.
weatherUnknown: No forecast is available for this period yet. Missing data does not mean good weather.
unknownCosts: Unknown prices and other currencies are not treated as free.
readyIntro: The same trip and documents. Planning stays separate from actual experiences.
handoverDone: The plan is released and remains editable.
noAutoCount: Releasing a plan confirms no visits. Past plan dates do not automatically count as experiences.
noPush: Hints stay in the app. Intentionally open points stay quiet.

parseAI: Use AI to read this document (otherwise templates only)
parseLocal: Document analysis permits a local provider only.
parseCloud: If you enable AI reading, configured and consented cloud providers are also permitted.
locationSource: Location data: Open-Meteo / GeoNames. Search and forecast retrieval only run when you ask.
groupPrice: Total booking price: counted once across all associated segments.
clothingGuide: Prepare clothes for around {{days}} days. Adjust quantities per item.
clothingUnknown: Travel dates help estimate clothing quantities.
packingGuide: Check cabin luggage limits, liquid rules and entry documents with the carrier or responsible authority.
